flags.message: Unusual grant shape for a moment: grant merits cell. Certiorari was granted on 2026-09-29 by treating the Government's stay application (26A406, filed 2026-09-24) as the petition, before the First Circuit's mandate and before any BIO or QP section existed; the Court framed the questions itself in the grant order. record/documents/ therefore holds only application.txt (kind=application, 45 pages, clean text) with no questions-presented.txt, petition.txt, or brief-in-opposition.txt, and the stay opposition (filed 2026-09-28, in the snapshot) was not provisioned. I retrieved the opposition and the First Circuit opinion myself (forward mode). No merits brief was on disk, as the moment requires.

Decisive forward signal predating and inside the snapshot: the 6-3 stay grant of 2026-09-29 in this same order (Sotomayor, Kagan, Jackson would deny), and the Court's prior 6-3 stay of the preliminary injunction in this case (24A1153, June 2025). These are provisioned docket facts, not retrieved outcome material; the judgment itself does not exist and no search surfaced one.
